text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen, listen! I was just walking
down the
cobblestone path with all the
trees, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well, suddenly I heard this noise coming
from the
trees! And guess what?! Go on,
guess!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I forgot while I was running here to tell
you!
Ahahahaha!
